purpose: a smartphone admissibility gate that refuses out-of-domain images before the classifier sees them
threshold_fit_on: a held-out 20% of HAM train, grouped by lesion, that the score itself was not fit on
selection_rule: highest PAD-dev rejection rate among candidates whose escalating-minus-benign rejection gap has an upper CI bound at or below +0.05

safety_constraint.statement: the gate must not reject escalating lesions more often than benign ones
safety_constraint.test: Newcombe score interval on the difference of PAD-dev rejection rates
safety_constraint.decides: a candidate failing this cannot be adopted regardless of its rejection rate

pad_split.note: PAD is developed on here and is not a fresh cohort; S73 does not read it again
